All CSV values are in **metric tons**. The downloads contain each source's full available annual series in the stated range. Catch totals follow the source's coverage; AKFIN and NOAA CAR110 are separate series. The specifications retain missing values and identify sums with missing entries. The GOA specifications source ends in 2024. Updated **29 September 2026**.
